comparison.eyebrow: Why a ChatGPT seat is not the same product

heading_parts.before_highlights: ChatGPT seats cost less for small teams. Choose OneAI when you need

comparison.lede: A fair objection: "We can give employees money, or buy ChatGPT Business." That makes sense for small teams with chat-only needs. ChatGPT Business already includes model usage, company knowledge, files, code, and admin controls. OneAI is a different product: multi-model access, on-prem or isolated hosting, and one budget across vendors.

not_for_you.title: Fewer than 20 people with chat-only needs
not_for_you.text: For that team size, ChatGPT Plus or Business is usually enough and cheaper. OneAI isn't meant to replace personal subscriptions at that scale.

good_fit.title: 20-40 people who need one platform, not 20-40 subscriptions
good_fit.text: One invoice of Rp12,400,000 for up to 40 users, including USD 300 credit across model providers, plus on-prem or isolated hosting, multi-model access, and local implementation. At 40 annual ChatGPT seats the prices are close. Buy the platform, not a cheaper chat seat.

comparison.table_label: Cost and capability comparison · per month
comparison.assumptions: Assumptions: Rp16,000/USD exchange rate. Stipend example Rp500,000/person/month. ChatGPT Business $25/user/month (monthly) or $20/user/month (annual). USD 300 credit ≈ Rp4,800,000. ChatGPT Business includes model usage; extra credits are optional. Competitor prices may change; figures are for comparison, not their quotes.

why_section.label: Why OneAI
why_section.heading: One platform beats three workarounds
why_section.desc: Stipends fail at control. ChatGPT Business is a strong single-vendor seat. OneAI is the platform when you need multiple models, isolated or on-prem hosting, and one budget across providers.

0.title: Stipends often don't become AI spending
0.text: Money in employee accounts can be spent on anything. There is no model reporting, no audit trail, and no way to enforce company policy. You pay for capacity you cannot see.

1.title: Seat price is not the product
1.text: At 40 users, ChatGPT Business is about Rp16 million monthly or Rp12.8 million annually. OneAI stays at Rp12.4 million for up to 40 users. Those prices are close. The case is one platform across vendors, not cheaper OpenAI chat.

2.title: ChatGPT already ships knowledge, files, and code
2.text: Company knowledge, connectors, office files, code, SSO, and admin controls are in ChatGPT Business today. OneAI adds multi-model choice, on-prem or isolated hosting, one budget across providers, and local implementation. That is not a claim that those features must be bought separately.

support.heading: If your company is in Indonesia, we are already next door
support.lede: You get engineers in the same timezone, who speak your language, and can sit with you in the office. Questions get answered during your workday: fast, direct, and easy. Support from companies like OpenAI will never feel like that.

0.text: Replies during Indonesian office hours, not after your team has gone home.

1.title: Bahasa Indonesia, no translation lag
1.text: Talk to engineers who already understand your stack, your constraints, and your language.

2.title: On-site when it matters
2.text: When a rollout needs someone in the room, we can come to you. A global ticket portal cannot.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.desc: Straight answers about the OneAI plan. Need more detail? Email us. We reply quickly.

0.question: How many users does the plan include?
0.answer: The standard OneAI plan covers up to 40 users. Need more seats or a phased rollout? Tell us your team size when you reach out.

1.question: How is billing structured?
1.answer: Rp12.400.000 per month before tax, invoiced quarterly (Rp37.200.000 per quarter before tax). Annual billing saves 10%.

2.question: What is Zero Data Retention (ZDR)?
2.answer: With ZDR, your company data is not retained for model training. You get AI productivity with a clear data-handling posture.

3.question: What is included in the plan?
3.answer: USD 300 in AI credits, one team training/orientation session, and monthly usage reports, plus centralized access to current models and admin controls.

4.question: Can you integrate with our internal systems or SSO?
4.answer: Yes. Custom integrations (internal systems, dedicated SSO, and similar requirements) are scoped and priced separately after we understand your environment.

5.question: What if we need more than 40 users?
5.answer: Contact us. If you need more than 40 users, we will scope a plan that fits your team size.

6.question: What happens if usage exceeds USD 300?
6.answer: If monthly usage exceeds the included USD 300 credit, your company can choose to completely suspend further requests, or allow more requests and be charged for the overage.

7.question: Where is OneAI installed? Does our data stay with us?
7.answer: Yes. OneAI is installed on your premises, so the platform, files, and usage data stay on your infrastructure. Hyperjump maintains the system. If you do not want to host it, we run OneAI on a dedicated isolated server for your company only, not shared with other customers.
